description: This file defines the interface ContentService which declares methods for managing content and content files within a CMS, including listing, retrieving, adding, and removing content and files related to merchant stores.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: Interface defining CRUD operations and content management functionalities for merchant store content and files.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists Content objects filtered by a single ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists Content objects filtered by multiple ContentTypes for a given MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code for a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new Content object or updates an existing one.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Stores a content file in the system for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific content file associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Fetches a specific content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all content files of a given type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Retrieves filenames of content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds or updates the store logo.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists Content objects by multiple ContentTypes for a merchant store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by ID and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SE (Search Engine) URL.
